nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Excludes node_modules, build output, git data, env files, the API and migrations from the web image build context.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Single-stage Node 22 image that installs dependencies, builds the Next.js site with env passed as a build secret, and runs next start on port 3000 as a non-root user.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses BuildKit --mount=type=secret so .env values never land in an image layer.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Local stack: web site, NestJS API, Postgres 17, SeaweedFS S3 storage with bucket bootstrap, a socat gateway and the Colissimo mock service.
